units.topic: in-house IT staffing and technical skills
units.summary: The IT function consists of Jari alone. He has good SQL and Power BI skills, but no Python or machine-learning experience.
units.quote: One-person IT function (Jari). Good SQL and Power BI skills, no Python/ML experience.

units.summary: The IT Manager handles systems, reporting and user support; network and security are outsourced.
units.quote: Systems, reporting, user support; network and security outsourced

units.summary: The company uses a WMS vendor under a support contract, a Business Central consultancy partner, and an IT outsourcing provider for network and security.
units.quote: External partners: WMS vendor (support contract), Business Central partner (Dynamics consultancy), IT outsourcing for network and security.

units.summary: The single-person IT function is identified as a bottleneck; any solution needs to be low-maintenance or operated by a partner.
units.quote: Risk: single IT person = bottleneck. Any solution must be low-maintenance or partner-operated.

units.summary: The IT Manager has read access to the WMS data.
The company has no data warehouse; reporting uses Excel exports and a few Power BI reports maintained by Jari.
units.quote: No data warehouse; reporting is done in Excel exports and a few Power BI reports that Jari maintains.

units.quote: No machine learning models in production.
